name: Chicken Stuffed Sweet Pedha
instructions:
1. Heat ghee in a pan. Add finely chopped onion, ginger-garlic paste, and chopped green chillies. Sauté until golden.
2. Add minced chicken, salt, garam masala, and cinnamon. Cook until the chicken is completely cooked and dry (no moisture remaining). Stir in chopped cashews and set aside to cool completely.
3. In a separate pan, crumble the khoya and heat on low. Add sugar and stir until melted and smooth. Stir in cardamom powder.
4. Turn off heat and allow the khoya mixture to cool slightly until warm and malleable like dough.
5. Take small balls of warm khoya dough, flatten them in your palm, place a small spoonful of cooled spiced chicken in the center, and gently seal into a smooth pedha disc.
6. Press a cashew or almond half on top and allow to set before serving.
